Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Reddy,

Thank you for meeting us on 3 May 2022 about your dispute with Fatima Pai. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Mumbai.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹6,10,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
